summary: Max Verstappen won the Spanish Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 2.2s ahead of Lando Norris, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Sergio Perez made the biggest climb, from P11 to P8.
Valtteri Bottas had a day to forget, dropping from P12 to P16.
The stewards penalised MAG (5 second time penalty), HUL (5 second time penalty) and TSU (5 second time penalty).
There were 42 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 69 points over Lando Norris.
